summary: The UserRepository.find_by_name method uses f-string interpolation to build SQL queries, which is vulnerable to SQL injection attacks. User input (name parameter) is directly concatenated into the query string without parameterization or sanitization.

items.description: SQL injection vulnerability in find_by_name: f-string interpolation of user input into SQL query. Use parameterized queries instead: cursor.execute('SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = ?', (name,)).
